name: Non-profit and events
description: Check volunteer rosters, event run-of-show timelines, budgets and grant drafts, from plain files. Roster finds double-booked people, uncovered shifts and understaffed ones, and adds up hours per person. Timeline finds overlaps and gaps in a run of show and gives the total length. Budget compares budget with actual by line and category, with variance and lines over budget. Grant checks a draft's headings and word counts against a checklist you type ("Section | max words"). Arithmetic and cross-checking on your own files; not financial, legal or grant-writing advice, and the tool does not know any funder's rules. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Volunteer roster check (CSV)
presets.description: Columns person, date, start, end, optional role and needed. Double-booked people, shifts with nobody assigned, shifts with fewer people than needed, hours per person, a day longer than maxday hours (default 8).

presets.label: Run-of-show timeline check (CSV)
presets.description: Columns start, end (or minutes) and item. Overlaps are errors, gaps are notes (warnings from 15 minutes), and the total length is given.

presets.label: Event budget against actual (CSV)
presets.description: Columns line, budget, actual and optional category. Variance and percent by line, totals, lines more than 10% over, spending with no budget, and totals by category.

presets.label: Grant draft against a checklist
presets.description: The draft is a markdown file with a heading per section. Type the path of the checklist (one "Section | max words" per line) in the extra arguments. Missing or empty sections, sections over the word limit, very short ones and leftover TODO placeholders.
